Policy on tag checks
The aim of this section is to explain how the desk handles it.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk checks every carrier tag against the booking record before handoff, after any reroute, and again if a carrier changes service path. The senior coordinator makes the final call when a tag is missing, unclear, or attached to the wrong carrier. Staff keep the process calm and direct, and they confirm the traveler’s details without adding extra handling steps.

When a traveler reports a delayed departure claim, the desk records the report in full and routes it through the normal service file. <<FACT F115>> The desk does not promise an outcome at the counter, and it does not estimate relief before the review is complete. If cabin overheating is reported, staff move the case to the service lead at once and note the condition of the animal, the carrier, and the cabin setting. <<FACT F111>> The desk keeps the record plain, factual, and free of guesswork.

The ground team handles carriers with care between services, while the welcome team prepares travelers for boarding and confirms that each animal is ready for the next step. Care plans must reflect species, temperament, and comfort needs, and the desk must follow the plan already on file unless the senior coordinator approves a change. If a tag issue cannot be resolved on the spot, staff hold the carrier, document the reason, and wait for direction.

For any unresolved case, contact the senior coordinator through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
